description: Update an existing Alert Severity in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_alert_severity afterwards to see the updated record.

color.description: Color of this resource in Hex (#32a852 for example).

description.description: Friendly description that will help you remember.
description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Alert Severity to update. Required. Use list_alert_severities to find IDs.

name.description: Any friendly name of this object.

order.description: Where this severity ranks among the project's alert severities: 1 is the most severe. A new severity without a number goes to the end of the list. Setting a number moves the severity to that place, and the ones in between shift by one. In the dashboard, drag the rows to reorder them.

name: update_alert_severity
title: Update Alert Severity
